title: Sightseeing in Paris
abstract: Sightseeing in Paris is a captivating blend of history, art, and culture. Start with the Eiffel Tower for sweeping city views, then visit the Louvre to see masterpieces like the Mona Lisa. Admire Notre-Dame’s Gothic architecture and explore Montmartre’s charming streets up to the Sacré-Cœur Basilica. From the bustling Champs-Élysées to the quiet corners of the Latin Quarter, every part of Paris invites discovery and enchantment.

packages.title: Classic Paris Highlights
packages.description: A full-day tour covering the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and a Seine River cruise.

packages.title: Romantic Paris
packages.description: Evening strolls through Montmartre, a candlelit dinner cruise on the Seine, and a visit to the Eiffel Tower at sunset.

packages.title: Gourmet Paris Experience

packages.title: Hidden Gems of Paris

packages.title: Family Fun in Paris
packages.description: Family-friendly activities like a treasure hunt at the Louvre, visits to kid-friendly parks, and a fun Seine River cruise tailored for younger travelers.
